Proof of Work

Projects

Real problems, and what actually resolved them.

Self-Hosted SIEM for a 12-Device Homelab

Problem — Off-the-shelf monitoring tools were either too shallow for real threat visibility or priced for enterprise budgets, leaving small setups blind to lateral movement.

Outcome — Built a self-hosted SIEM stack (Wazuh + Proxmox VLANs) giving full log visibility and alerting for under $0 in licensing, now used as a reference architecture for client engagements.

Wazuh Proxmox Networking Self-Hosted

Advanced Self-Hosting Infrastructure (Docker + Reverse Proxy)

Problem — Relying on third-party platforms for services like file storage, media streaming, and code hosting often compromises control, privacy, and scalability.

Solution — Deployed a self-hosted infrastructure running on Docker containers, with applications such as Nextcloud, Jellyfin, Gitea, and Syncthing. Secured the environment with a Traefik reverse proxy, a WAF, and automated SSL/TLS.

Outcome — A scalable, secure, and private platform, enabling complete ownership of data and services while maintaining high availability and performance.

Docker Traefik WAF SSL/TLS Nextcloud Self-Hosted

48-Hour Incident Response for an SME Ransomware Case

Problem — A small business suffered a ransomware incident with no prior backup strategy and no internal security staff to triage it.

Outcome — Contained the breach, recovered critical data from a partial backup, and rebuilt the network with segmented access — the business resumed operations within 48 hours with zero ransom paid.

Incident Response Ransomware Backup Strategy

Custom OpenWrt Firmware & Router Configuration

Problem — Off-the-shelf router firmware lacked the features, security controls, and customization required for advanced labs and real-world security use cases.

Solution — Built and maintained a custom OpenWrt firmware, integrating a captive portal, custom firewall rules, QoS tweaks, logging/monitoring hooks, and secure update mechanisms.

Outcome — Turned consumer-grade routers into secure, policy-driven networking appliances — reducing attack surface and enabling guest isolation, SIEM-ready telemetry, and improved performance.

OpenWrt Firmware Networking Captive Portal QoS

WordPress E-Commerce Website (Client Project)

Problem — A client needed a fast, secure, and reliable e-commerce platform to support growing online sales, but off-the-shelf hosting solutions were slow and insecure.

Solution — Designed and deployed a custom WooCommerce site on a manually optimized LAMP stack, integrating Memcached for server-side caching, client-side caching plugins, SSL/TLS with auto-renewal, MFA, firewall rules, and backup systems. Also handled Cloudflare DNS management, SEO optimization, and multi-payment gateway integration (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, cards, and bank transactions).

Outcome — A high-performance, secure e-commerce website that improved customer experience, boosted sales, and gave the client a scalable foundation for future growth.

WordPress WooCommerce LAMP Memcached Cloudflare Payment Gateways

Security Information & Event Management (SIEM) with Wazuh & ELK

Problem — Modern infrastructures generate massive amounts of logs, but without centralized monitoring, threats can go unnoticed until damage is done.

Solution — Architected and deployed a SIEM solution using Wazuh, the ELK Stack, and Elasticsearch, integrating log collection, real-time alerting, and visualization dashboards.

Outcome — Enabled proactive threat detection and streamlined incident response, improving visibility across systems and reducing mean time to detection (MTTD).

Wazuh ELK Stack Elasticsearch SIEM Threat Detection

Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (Snort & Suricata)

Problem — Unmonitored network traffic leaves systems vulnerable to undetected intrusions and malicious activity.

Solution — Implemented and tuned Snort and Suricata IDS/IPS systems, building rulesets to detect and block suspicious traffic patterns, tested in both lab and production-like environments.

Outcome — Provided early warning against network-based threats, reducing the attack surface and enhancing overall network security posture.

Snort Suricata IDS/IPS Network Security

Exploit Development & Game Hacking (Research)

Problem — Understanding software vulnerabilities at a deep level requires working hands-on with low-level systems, memory, and reverse engineering challenges.

Solution — Conducted exploit development and game hacking research projects — writing proof-of-concept exploits, reverse engineering binaries, and creating mods and automation scripts for games.

Outcome — Sharpened skills in reverse engineering, secure coding practices, and vulnerability research — directly improving the ability to identify and mitigate real-world software security flaws.

Reverse Engineering Exploit Development Vulnerability Research

Telegram Battery Status Bot

Problem — Users often forget to monitor battery health and charging status on their devices, which can shorten battery lifespan or lead to sudden shutdowns.

Solution — Built a lightweight Telegram bot that monitors battery status and sends real-time alerts, providing insight into charging health and thresholds.

Outcome — Automated a simple but valuable use case, demonstrating practical automation with Python scripting, API integration, and lightweight notifications that improve user convenience.

Python Telegram API Automation

AI Music Remover (In Progress)

Problem — Video editors and content creators often struggle with separating vocals from instrumentals in audio tracks for remixing, karaoke, or background scoring.

Solution — Developing an AI-powered tool that leverages machine learning models to isolate vocals and instruments with high accuracy — training and fine-tuning separation models and integrating them into a user-friendly interface.

Outcome — Will enable creators to work more flexibly with audio, reducing reliance on expensive proprietary software while showcasing expertise in machine learning, signal processing, and AI application development.

Machine Learning Signal Processing Python AI
